review.reason: The cited passages support the main chain: automotive ADAS/V2X and Automotive SerDes require high-speed links; PCB/SI flows measure IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, DK/DF, roughness, return loss/impedance; and VNA-based solutions include probing, de-embedding, frequency range, dynamic range, time-domain options, and sweep/bandwidth specifications. Some capability-to-requirement links are inferred rather than explicitly stated, but they are reasonable engineering mappings from the evidence.
